display.summary: The titlebar can now group its optional actions behind one caret beside the user hub, so the title keeps its room instead of being squeezed out by buttons that never shrink.
highlights: New titlebar setting: Scattered (unchanged, the default) or Grouped, which folds every optional action into a rail under the bar.
Narrow screens group regardless — the actions no longer overlap each other past the width where they stop fitting.
Titlebar action order can be dragged by its grip; the up/down buttons remain the keyboard path.
Inline installation of this release needs Composer 1.3.10, the first version that can activate a schema-2 release.
